comparison.objective: Install and rotationally check a circlip in a shaft groove; candidate installs a collet into an eccentric nut ring.
comparison.physical_skill: Pliers-mediated ring spreading, planar seating, and in-groove turning versus bimanual collet stabilization and tilt-and-roll snap capture.
comparison.success_condition: Circlip seated without over-spread/twist, pliers released, and rotation check completed versus collet retained after release and withdrawal check.
comparison.reason: Both produce groove retention, but they test materially different mechanisms and actions. Candidate lacks numeric snap/deformation limits.
